soldier: Head dark yellowish brown, mandibles dark reddish brown, pilosity of the head capsule moderate. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.54–0.59, lateral margins parallel, the middle of the posterior margin straight; frontal peaks slightly raised, the two peaks distinguishable. Labrum ligulate, broadly rounded at the apex, but the transparent tip slightly pointed and nearly triangular; apical and subapical setae present, lateral apical setae slender and short. Mandibles rather stout, apex slightly more curved; length 0.55–0.57 of head capsule length and 0.94–0.98 of head width. Antennae incomplete. Widest part of the postmentum at the anterior fifth, anterior lateral margins trapezoidal and widening posteriorly; waist region slender and long, waist constriction index 0.26–0.30. Pronotum trapezoidal, 1.5–1.6 times as wide as long, anterior and posterior margins both nearly straight, the anterior margin shallowly notched in the middle, the posterior margin with almost no visible incision; about 16 setae in the middle region.
taxonomy_note: The letters of the genus name are defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; this is in fact Reticulitermes, the same genus name as used on this site.
